title: Mimms Museum of Technology and Art

services.name: Admission
services.desc: Before the idea of a permanent space was a reality, over the past several years, Mimms Museum of Technology and Art has opened for a series of private shows and events in a “vintage” Comp USA building in Roswell, GA. These temporary “pop-up exhibits” served as a “test kitchen” for feedback, input and response from visitors, and informed the plans to develop the museum’s ultimate design and location. The Apple Pop-Up Exhibit followed the journey of Apple from its founding in a garage to becoming one of the most innovative and influential companies in the world. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Mimms Museum of Technology and Art is a great place for school field trips whether you have a class of 10 or a team of 120! We are close by in Roswell with easy access from GA 400 and there’s plenty of free parking for school or charter buses. Our exhibitions cover a variety of Georgia Standards of Excellence in Math, Science, Social Studies, and of course, Computer Science. Additionally, there are lots of opportunities to explore Business, Marketing, Art, Design, and Language Arts.
